jei.slowlight.info.flower_press: Put any flower in the Flower Press and three days later it comes out a Pressed Flower. A hopper above or beside the press feeds it, and one below takes the pressed flowers out. A comparator reads how far along it is. A redstone pulse pops a pressed flower out of the front.
jei.slowlight.info.pressed_flower: Made in the Flower Press from any flower over three days, and it keeps the look of the flower it was. Use it on the ground or on a wall to lay it there; up to four share one spot.
jei.slowlight.info.letter_to_later: Craft a signed book with a honeycomb anywhere in the grid. Sneak and use the letter to pick how long it keeps, from a day to a year, then use it to seal it. Once those days pass, use it again to get your book back.
jei.slowlight.info.chorus_pearl: A Waystone burns one Chorus Pearl for every stack it sends. Leave two on the ground together and in about a minute they fuse into a Twin Pearl.
jei.slowlight.info.twin_pearl: Leave two Chorus Pearls lying on the ground together for about a minute and they fuse into this. Set it in a Waystone and the stone keeps one half and hands you the other.
jei.slowlight.info.half_pearl: The half of a Twin Pearl that the first Waystone gave back. Set it in a second Waystone to pair the two stones. Break one stone of a pair and it drops a Half Pearl that points to the one still standing.
jei.slowlight.info.lanternfruit_peel: Left in the grid whenever you craft with a Lanternfruit.
